notes: The programme page does not state an application deadline specifically for non-EU/foreign-qualification applicants; the deadline 2 May 2027 is listed without qualification, so it is recorded only as a recurring (month/day) deadline. The application channel hu-university-direct is inferred from the general admission page stating to submit the application via the online application system; the programme page itself does not name a platform. Tuition 3600 EUR is the Non-EU/EEA fee stated per semester on the programme page (evidence quote juxtaposes EU/EEA and non-EU/EEA fees; 3600 EUR is the non-EU/EEA figure).

note.fr: Vérifiez que votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires permet l'accès à l'université et consultez la liste des certificats acceptés et non acceptés.
note.en: Check that your secondary school diploma allows direct access to tertiary education and review the list of accepted and non-accepted certificates.

evidence.quote: the application of those prospective students is welcome who have completed their secondary school studies and can provide proof of this by presenting a secondary or high school diploma (or equivalent), which allows direct access to tertiary/higher education

note.fr: Les examens en mathématiques, mathématiques approfondies, économie, études commerciales, comptabilité, informatique et histoire sont fortement souhaités; vérifiez les scores minimaux pour les examens équivalents (par ex. GED 175).
note.en: Exams in Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Economics, Business studies, Accounting, Computer science and History are highly desirable; check minimum scores for equivalent exams (e.g. GED 175+).

evidence.quote: exams in the following subjects are highly desirable: Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Economics, Business studies, Accounting, Computer science, History.
for example, GED, the minimum required scores are 175+ to be considered as a potential applicant.
